verses.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. And everyone who loves the Father also loves the child born of him.
This is how we know that we love God's children: when we love God and obey his commands.
Loving God means obeying his commands. And his commands are not too hard for us.
Everyone born of God wins against the world. And this is the victory that has won against the world: our faith.
Who can win against the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus Christ is the one who came by water and blood. He came not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. And the Spirit tells us this is true, because the Spirit is the truth.
So there are three that tell us about him:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood. And the three agree as one.
We accept what people tell us, but what God tells us is greater. And this is what God has said about his Son.
Anyone who believes in the Son of God has God's witness in his heart. Anyone who does not believe God has made God a liar, because he has not believed what God has said about his Son.
And this is what God has said: God has given us life that lasts forever, and this life is in his Son.
Anyone who has the Son has life. Anyone who does not have the Son of God does not have life.
I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you can know that you have life that lasts forever, and so that you keep believing in the name of the Son of God.
This is how bold we can be when we come to God: if we ask for anything that is what he wants, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us whatever we ask, we know that we already have what we asked him for.

If anyone sees his brother doing a sin that does not lead to death, he should pray, and God will give that person life. I mean those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying he should pray about that.
All wrongdoing is sin, but there is sin that does not lead to death.
We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning. The Son who was born of God keeps him safe, and the evil one cannot touch him.
We know that we belong to God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.

We know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we can know the one who is true. And we are in the one who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and life that lasts forever.
Little children, keep yourselves away from idols.
